services.desc: This popular event is back for 2026 and is open to all Webelos, Arrow of Light Scouts, Den Chiefs, and their leaders and parents. This program combines learning and fun, during a program where den leaders can pre-select badges and activities their Scouts can work towards during the weekend. In addition to activity badge opportunities, Scouts will have the opportunity to participate in range and target activities, climbing, enjoy a special program, and a campwide campfire on Saturday evening.
